description: This file is a shell script that contains tests and utility functions related to Git's partial clone functionality, including setup, fetch operations, and object consistency checks.

methods.name: delete_object
methods.description: Deletes a specific object file from the repository based on its hash.

methods.name: pack_as_from_promisor
methods.description: Creates a packfile for the given object hash, assuming the object is promisor/partial.

methods.name: promise_and_delete
methods.description: Promises an object by creating a tag or branch and then deletes the original object if referenced only from reflog or tag.

methods.name: repack_and_check
methods.description: Recreates the repository via repack with different options and verifies the integrity and presence of specific objects, especially promisor objects.
